title: Geometric finiteness in paracomplex hyperbolic spaces
summary: We develop a framework for studying discrete subgroups of $\mathsf{PGL}(d+1,\mathbb{R})$ via the paracomplex hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}_τ^d$, a rank-$1$ pseudo-Riemannian symmetric space. We characterize projective transverse, relatively Anosov, and Anosov subgroups in terms of properly discontinuous, geometrically finite, and convex-cocompact actions respectively on their weak hulls, which are canonical flow spaces in the spacelike unit tangent bundle of $\mathbb{H}_τ^d$.
